go_migration_runner_design_summary.schema_migrations_columns: (filename TEXT PK, checksum TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
go_migration_runner_design_summary.transaction_model: Each migration runs in its own BEGIN/COMMIT. Partial failures roll back cleanly. The schema_migrations row is INSERTed in the same transaction as the migration effect.
go_migration_runner_design_summary.checksum: SHA256 of file content. Recorded on first apply. Re-running apply on a previously-applied row refuses to proceed if the recorded checksum differs from the file's current SHA256.
go_migration_runner_design_summary.legacy_backfill: If a schema_migrations row has checksum='' (legacy pre-Go runner), Apply backfills with the current file's SHA256 on first run. The migration is not re-applied (it's already applied); only the checksum is updated.
go_migration_runner_design_summary.production_dsn_guard: Refuses DSN containing 'supabase.co', 'rds.amazonaws.com', 'prod', or 'production' unless LPBOT_MIGRATE_ALLOW_LIVE=YES or cfg.AllowLiveDSN=true
go_migration_runner_design_summary.env_files_autoloaded: NONE. POSTGRES_DSN or DATABASE_URL must be set explicitly. Does NOT auto-load .env.canary, .env.live, or any canary/live env.
go_migration_runner_design_summary.shell_wrapper_role: scripts/migrate-postgres.sh is retained as a thin legacy alias; Makefile migrate-postgres* targets now invoke the Go binary

000004_handling.decision: Not modified the SQL file. Idempotency protection provided by runner-level guards.
000004_handling.rationale: 000004 has been applied to 0 production DBs per the freeze. The Go runner handles partial-failure scenarios via transaction-per-migration (the UPDATE rolls back if any subsequent statement fails) and checksum-mismatch detection (re-running on a partially-applied DB refuses to proceed rather than producing inconsistent state).
